dialogue.origin: （2試合目、お願いいたします。）
dialogue.content: (Round 2, please.)

dialogue.origin: （はい）
dialogue.content: (Yes.)

dialogue.origin: カウンセラー役です。お願いいたします。
dialogue.content: I'll be playing the role of the counselor. It's a pleasure to work with you.

dialogue.origin: よろしくお願い致します
dialogue.content: Likewise, thank you.

dialogue.origin: （こちらから何か言うのですか？）
dialogue.content: (Am I supposed to say something first?)

dialogue.origin: いえ、こちらからお声がけしますね。開始の合図とともに初めますね。お願いいたします。
dialogue.content: No, I'll start the conversation. We'll begin with the signal. Thank you.

dialogue.origin: 今、マッチング確認中だそうなので！
dialogue.content: It seems they're confirming the matching now!

dialogue.origin: 承知致しました。
dialogue.content: Understood.

dialogue.origin: こんにちは、相談員です。勇気をもってご相談して頂きありがとうございます。本日はどういったご相談でいらっしゃいますか？
dialogue.content: Hello, I'm a counselor. Thank you for having the courage to reach out to us. What brings you here today?

dialogue.origin: 学校のことです
dialogue.content: It's about school.

dialogue.origin: 学校でのお悩みですね。辛いですよね。もう少し詳しく教えていただくことは可能でしょうか？
dialogue.content: I see, something about school is troubling you. That must be difficult. Would you be willing to tell me a bit more about it?

dialogue.origin: クラスの子たちから陰口を言われています
dialogue.content: My classmates are talking behind my back.

dialogue.origin: 学校に行きたくないです
dialogue.content: I don't want to go to school.

dialogue.origin: それは本当に辛いですよね。。いつ頃から言われているのですか？
dialogue.content: That sounds truly painful. About when did this start?

dialogue.origin: 9月頃からです
dialogue.content: Since around September.

dialogue.origin: なんと、、3ヶ月も前からなんですね。。
dialogue.content: Wow... so it's been going on for three months now.

dialogue.origin: はい、、
dialogue.content: Yes...

dialogue.origin: その間本当に苦しかったと思います。。
dialogue.content: I can only imagine how hard it must have been for you all this time.

dialogue.origin: でも、その前からも、あまりみんなに馴染めなかったです
dialogue.content: But even before that, I didn't really fit in with everyone.

dialogue.origin: そうだったんですね、、その前から苦しかったんですね。。
dialogue.content: I see... so you've been struggling even before this started.

dialogue.origin: これまで相談出来る方はいたりしましたか？
dialogue.content: Have you had anyone you could talk to about this so far?

dialogue.origin: 苦しかったというか、、なんか居場所がないって言うか、、
dialogue.content: It wasn't so much that it was hard... it was more like... I felt like I didn't have a place to belong.

dialogue.origin: 誰も聞いてくれないです
dialogue.content: No one listens to me.

dialogue.origin: なるほど、居場所がなく感じていたのですね。。
dialogue.content: I see, so you've been feeling like you don't have a place where you belong.

dialogue.origin: そうだったのですね。。今日は勇気をもって相談してもらえてよかったです。
dialogue.content: I understand. I'm really glad you found the courage to talk to me about this today.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 今日は一緒に考えていきましょうね。
dialogue.content: Let's think this through together today.

dialogue.origin: よろしくお願いします
dialogue.content: Thank you.

dialogue.origin: ちなみに、学年は何年生ですか？
dialogue.content: By the way, what grade are you in?

dialogue.origin: 高2、女、です。
dialogue.content: I'm a girl in my second year of high school.

dialogue.origin: 教えてくれてありがとうございます。
dialogue.content: Thank you for telling me.

dialogue.origin: 質問ですが、
dialogue.content: I have a question,

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes?

dialogue.origin: 陰口を言われてしまった事に対して心あたりはあったりするのですか？
dialogue.content: Do you have any idea why they might be talking behind your back?

dialogue.origin: うーん
dialogue.content: Hmm...

dialogue.origin: 制服とか、髪型がダサいって言われますでも、家は親が厳しくて、校則通りじゃないとダメなんです
dialogue.content: They say my uniform and my hairstyle are uncool... but my parents are very strict, and I have to follow the school rules exactly.

dialogue.origin: そうだったのですね。。それはつらかったですね。。
dialogue.content: I see... That must have been very hard for you.

dialogue.origin: はい、、
dialogue.content: Yes...

dialogue.origin: 本当はどんな格好をしたかったのですか？
dialogue.content: What kind of style did you really want to have?

dialogue.origin: うーん、、みんなと同じような感じなら、何も言われないのかな？
dialogue.content: Hmm... if I looked like everyone else, maybe they wouldn't say anything?

dialogue.origin: わからないです
dialogue.content: I don't know.

dialogue.origin: そんな事言われたら、わからなくなってしまうのも無理ないですよね。
dialogue.content: After being told things like that, it's completely understandable that you wouldn't know anymore.

dialogue.origin: 私はただ、普通に学校に行ければ良いですでも、今はクラスが辛いんです
dialogue.content: I just want to be able to go to school normally. But right now, being in my class is too painful.

dialogue.origin: ええ
dialogue.content: Mm-hmm.

dialogue.origin: 学校に行きたくないです
dialogue.content: I don't want to go to school.

dialogue.origin: ずっとお休みが続けば良いけど…
dialogue.content: I wish the break would just go on forever...

dialogue.origin: 家も居心地がいいわけじゃないし…
dialogue.content: But it's not like home is a comfortable place for me either...

dialogue.origin: どこにも居場所がない
dialogue.content: I don't have a place to belong anywhere.

dialogue.origin: そうですよね。いきたいけど、陰口なんて言われたら今はいきたくない気持ちになるのも無理ないよね。。
dialogue.content: I understand. You want to go, but it's totally understandable that you wouldn't want to go right now, with people talking behind your back.

dialogue.origin: はい、みんな私が嫌いなんです
dialogue.content: Yes, everyone hates me.

dialogue.origin: そうだったんですね。。家でも辛かったんだね。。
dialogue.content: I see... So things are difficult at home, too.

dialogue.origin: 私の気持ちもわかってくれないし、、
dialogue.content: They don't understand how I feel, either...

dialogue.origin: みんなが嫌いと感じるほど、追い込まれていたんだね、、
dialogue.content: You've been pushed into such a corner that you feel like everyone hates you...

dialogue.origin: 本当に辛かったね、、
dialogue.content: That must have been so painful.

dialogue.origin: みんなが私を嫌いなんです
dialogue.content: Everyone hates me.

dialogue.origin: 辛かったよね、、どうしてそう感じるのかな？
dialogue.content: It's been so hard. What makes you feel that way?

dialogue.origin: お家ではどうしてみんな嫌いだと感じたのかな？
dialogue.content: And at home, what makes you feel that way?

dialogue.origin: 陰口を聞こえるように言ったり、無視したり、グループ分けの時に一人になったり、、
dialogue.content: They whisper about me loud enough for me to hear, they ignore me, and I'm left alone when we have to form groups.

dialogue.origin: うんうん、、
dialogue.content: Mm-hmm, mm-hmm...

dialogue.origin: 家では私の言うことなんか聞いてくれません学校に行きたくないのに、
dialogue.content: At home, they don't listen to what I have to say. Even though I don't want to go to school,

dialogue.origin: 行けと言われる
dialogue.content: they tell me I have to go.

dialogue.origin: 分かってない
dialogue.content: They just don't get it.

dialogue.origin: そっかそっか、、そんな事があったんだね、、苦しかったよね。。。
dialogue.content: I see, I see... so that's what's been happening. That must have been so difficult.

dialogue.origin: はい、、
dialogue.content: Yes...

dialogue.origin: そんな辛い中、相談してくれて本当に良かったよ。
dialogue.content: I'm so glad you reached out to talk about it, especially when things are so tough.

dialogue.origin: どうしたら良いですか？
dialogue.content: What should I do?

dialogue.origin: 一緒に考えて行こうね。
dialogue.content: Let's figure it out together.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Okay.

dialogue.origin: 学校ではお話しできる子は今までいたかな？
dialogue.content: Have you had anyone at school you could talk to before?

dialogue.origin: はい、グループって訳じゃないけど、話せる人はいました
dialogue.content: Yes, not like we were in a group or anything, but there were people I could talk to.

dialogue.origin: でも、今はみんなのことを気にして、
dialogue.content: But now, they're worried about what everyone else thinks,

dialogue.origin: あんまり話してくれない
dialogue.content: so they don't really talk to me much anymore.

dialogue.origin: そっかそっか、、
dialogue.content: I see...

dialogue.origin: いたのに、話してくれないんだね。。それは本当に不安になるよね。。
dialogue.content: So you had people to talk to, but now they won't... That must make you feel really anxious.

dialogue.origin: はい、、
dialogue.content: Yes...

dialogue.origin: ここまでの状況を一旦整理するね。
dialogue.content: Let's take a moment to summarize the situation so far.

dialogue.origin: はい、お願いします
dialogue.content: Okay, please.

dialogue.origin: クラスの子たちから陰口をいわれ学校で居場所がなく、行きたくない気持ち。
dialogue.content: The kids in your class are talking behind your back, you feel like you don't belong at school, and you don't want to go.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 家では、家族も話をきいてくれない状況ということだね。
dialogue.content: And at home, your family isn't listening to what you have to say.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 本当は学校にも行きたいけど、居場所がなく、どうして良いかわからない感じということだよね。
dialogue.content: So you actually want to go to school, but you feel like you don't belong and you don't know what to do. Is that right?

dialogue.origin: 家にいてもしんどいし、ただ、普通に学校に行ければ良いんです、、
dialogue.content: It's tough being at home, too. I just want to be able to go to school normally...

dialogue.origin: そうなんだね。。普通に学校いきたいよね。
dialogue.content: I understand. You just want to go to school normally.

dialogue.origin: 先生とはどんな感じかな？
dialogue.content: What's your relationship with your teachers like?

dialogue.origin: 先生は死にかけてくれていて…
dialogue.content: My teacher is concerned about me...

dialogue.origin: 気にかけて
dialogue.content: I mean, they're concerned about me.

dialogue.origin: そっかそっか、
dialogue.content: I see,

dialogue.origin: でも、そのせいで余計に陰口を言われる気がします
dialogue.content: But I feel like that makes them talk about me even more.

dialogue.origin: なるほど、そのように感じているんだね。。
dialogue.content: I see, so that's how it feels to you.

dialogue.origin: 先生には今の状況はつたえらえているかな？
dialogue.content: Have you been able to tell your teacher about the current situation?

dialogue.origin: 言えないです
dialogue.content: I can't.

dialogue.origin: 余計にひどくなる
dialogue.content: It'll just get worse.

dialogue.origin: そっかそっか、ひどくなったらと思ったら言いづらいよね。。
dialogue.content: I see. It's hard to speak up when you're afraid it might make things worse.

dialogue.origin: はい、どうしたら良いですか？
dialogue.content: Yes... what should I do?

dialogue.origin: うーん、まずは本音を話せる人を見つけれられたらいいと思うけど、どう思う？
dialogue.content: Hmm, I think a good first step would be to find someone you can be completely honest with. What do you think about that?

dialogue.origin: 本音、、
dialogue.content: My true feelings...

dialogue.origin: うん。家族に本当のことは話せなそうかな？
dialogue.content: Yes. Do you think you could talk to your family about what's really going on?

dialogue.origin: 家族は聞いてくれないんです
dialogue.content: My family won't listen.

dialogue.origin: 学校には行くもんだって、、
dialogue.content: They just say that school is a place you have to go...

dialogue.origin: それだけ
dialogue.content: That's it.

dialogue.origin: そっか、そっか、そう言われてしまったんだね。辛かったね。。
dialogue.content: I see... so that's what they said to you. That must have hurt.

dialogue.origin: （ありがとうございました！）
dialogue.content: (Thank you very much!)

topic.sub: クラスの子たちからの陰口問題
